description: Fix User model password cast to respect bcrypt rounds from config/hashing.php
changes: Modified User model (laravel/app/Models/User.php) to use custom setPasswordAttribute mutator with Hash::make() and config('hashing.bcrypt.rounds')
Updated UserFactory (laravel/database/factories/UserFactory.php) to respect configured bcrypt rounds
Added unit tests (laravel/tests/Unit/UserPasswordHashTest.php) verifying bcrypt rounds match config value
